value.author: pi-grok
value.text:
Cubic review 5395516638 on head b15bf93, land-pass disposition:

4168776167 is valid. Note 3 began with a pasted author=codex,text= label. pm item notes --edit 3 stripped that prefix so the text starts at "CodeRabbit review comment 4124694533". The original note_add history line is kept; the edit is a new history event.

4168776160 is refused. tokenize selects LanguageVariant.JSX only when the file identifier ends with .tsx, which is the same rule collectSourceFiles uses to admit sources. analyzeSource's file argument is that identifier, not a free-form module name. Inferring JSX from source text would treat TypeScript generics in .ts files as tags. A caller that passes TSX bytes under a non-.tsx name is outside the gate contract; the walker never does that.

4168776178 is refused. A live jscpd 5.2.1 JSON report stores statistics.formats.typescript.sources and statistics.total.sources as counts, not file maps. Duplicate records name only files that participated in a clone. The one-token probe therefore cannot name a same-size substitution, and the function comment above analyzeWithBinary already states that the JSON report carries only aggregate source counts. jscpd 4 still fails closed with skippedSources file names.
